test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All teas are juices.

All juices are cocktails.

**Conclusions:**

I. All teas are cocktails.

II. All cocktails are definitely juices.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Given Statements:**

All teas are juices.

All juices are cocktails.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/964c20aa78d5c82911928d78262b6183e7bf35bcc61a930535d349f9790202db.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All teas are cocktails. → **True **(It is given that all tea are juice and all juice are cocktail, so all tea will be cocktail also.)

II. All cocktails are definitely juices. → **False **(It is given that all juices are cocktails it means all juice are part of cocktails. So, all cocktails can never be juices).

So, Only **Conclusion I** follows.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***
